occupations.title: Project Management Specialists

occupations.title: Web and Digital Interface Designers
occupations.rationale: The excerpts show a "Website Redesign Project" being managed, with specific tasks assigned to designers such as creating visual mockups, defining button states, and designing pages [D:Basecamp:landing:7, D:Basecamp:landing:9, D:Basecamp:landing:10, D:Basecamp:landing:13].

occupations.title: Marketing Managers
occupations.rationale: The software is used to manage a "Website Redesign Project," including coordinating the project launch, gathering brand assets, and managing client communications, all of which are typical responsibilities for a marketing manager [D:Basecamp:landing:1, D:Basecamp:landing:6, D:Basecamp:landing:10].
